A landfill sitting on the orange
curve simply aged three years. Above
it, room was added or intake slowed.
Below it, the hole is filling faster
The gradient between the two shaded
permits new room, and it permits it
where the clock is short. 39% of all
the new tonnage went to the 18% of
68 marks sit on an axis bound
Across these 811 sites the room grew: 13.9bn tons left in 2021, 14.1bn in 2024, after burying 1.0bn, because 1.5bn tons of new capacity was permitted. Scarcity is local, not national.
Measured scale-free: a 10% intake change moves a 100-year site by ten years and a 10-year site by one. Spearman of log countdown against log ratio: -0.28, p < 0.0001, n = 824.
Two editions is one interval. Room was replaced once, between 2021 and 2024; whether that is normal, the register no longer holds the years to say.
